svg.aria-label: oUpdate by AKA Security, an open-source package firewall that reads what each new release changed before it lands. Illustration: update trucks for npm, pnpm, bun and brew wait in a striped cooldown lot; under an overhead board reading review one flagged truck's lane is closed, and a gate releases the rest onto the open road.
svg.title: oUpdate
